profile.summary: Cravatex Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in trading in branded sports goods and fitness equipment textiles in India and internationally. It also operates a license of FILA and Sergio Tacchini brand. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Cravatex Limited is a subsidiary of R.B. Fitness and Trading Private Limited.
